rules.source_evidence: OpenRAM bitcell_array/replica_bitcell_array source; reference GDS dense bitcell region
rules.rule_description: Bitcell array must be the dominant physical core of the macro and own row/column pitch, BL/BR access, and WL access.
rules.required_geometry: Real bitcell-array boundary plus per-column BL/BR shapes and per-row WL shapes.
rules.required_metadata: row_pitch, column_pitch, bitcell orientation parity, array bbox.

rules.rule_description: Row pitch and column pitch must derive from placed bitcell geometry, not top-level heuristic spacing.
rules.required_geometry: Measured bitcell width/height and instance placement lattice.

rules.rule_description: BL/BR access must be geometry-backed full-height array pins tied to real child pin layers.
rules.required_geometry: Vertical BL/BR pin rectangles aligned to bitcell access points.
rules.required_metadata: per-column net naming and source-target access ownership.

rules.rule_description: Each WL must have row-specific geometry-backed access aligned to row pitch.
rules.required_geometry: Per-row WL pin rectangles and driver landing shapes.
rules.required_metadata: row index to wl net map and row-order parity.

rules.rule_description: Dummy, replica, and cap structures must sit on array boundaries with defined timing/edge roles.
rules.required_geometry: Replica columns left/right, dummy rows top/bottom, optional cap cells around perimeter.
rules.required_metadata: which edges host replica or dummy structures and why.

rules.rule_description: VDD/GND array access must be copied from real child rails before any top-level strap stitching.
rules.required_geometry: Per-instance supply pins or continuous rail shapes at the array edge.
